title: Selenium-driven pex-miR-219 expression promotes regeneration in earthworms Perionyx excavatus.
authors: Subramaniam, Ravichandran; Selvan Christyraj, Johnson Retnaraj Samuel; Pantam, Vyankatesh; Senthilkumar, Priyadarshini; Selvan Christyraj, Jackson Durairaj; Azhaguchamy, Muthukumaran; Yesudhason, Beryl Vedha
one_liner_zh: 该文研究硒通过抑制pex-miR-219上调转录因子Su(H)促进蚯蚓再生，虽涉及miRNA-Su(H)结合和分子动力学模拟，但核心是miRNA-mRNA互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅部分方法可借鉴。
abstract: Selenium, an essential trace element, plays a critical role in antioxidant defence and cellular homeostasis. Selenium injection (500 nM to 300 microM) significantly enhanced anterior blastema regeneration in the earthworm Perionyx excavatus, with maximal blastema length observed at 300 microM (4.30 +/- 0.12 mm vs. 3.09 +/- 0.08 mm in controls). Histological analysis revealed concentration-dependent tissue restoration, including longitudinal muscle layer thickness (40.9 +/- 0.43 microm at 300 microM vs. 29.5 +/- 0.38 microm in controls) and expansion of epithelial/circular muscle layers. Quantitative PCR identified pex-miR-219 as uniquely suppressed by selenium, showing progressive downregulation (0.60-, 0.47-, 0.36-, and 0.22-fold at 1 microM, 100 microM, 200 microM, and 300 microM, respectively; p < 0.001). Computational target prediction (miRanda, RNAhybrid, RNA22) and qPCR validation confirmed transcription factor Su(H) as a high-affinity target of pex-miR-219, with Su(H) mRNA upregulated 8.26-fold at 300 microM (p < 0.001). Molecular dynamics simulations demonstrated stable binding between pex-miR-219 and Su(H), evidenced by RMSD stabilization (~ 0.25 nm after 4 ns), low RMSF in helical regions, and persistent hydrogen bonds (30-35 bonds). These findings establish a selenium-mediated regulatory axis where suppression of pex-miR-219 relieves Su(H) repression, accelerating blastemal growth and tissue restoration. The study shows that selenium could be used as a treatment to influence miRNA pathways, which helps improve healing processes. By elucidating the pex-miR-219/Su(H) interaction, this work provides a molecular framework for developing selenium-based interventions in regenerative medicine, particularly for conditions requiring accelerated tissue repair, such as wound healing or post-traumatic regeneration. These insights could inform future strategies to harness trace elements for targeted gene regulation in human regenerative therapies. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: The online version contains supplementary material available at 10.1007/s13205-025-04406-2.
abstract_zh: 硒（Selenium）作为一种必需微量元素，在抗氧化防御和细胞稳态中发挥关键作用。硒注射（500 nM至300微M）显著增强了蚯蚓（Perionyx excavatus）前部胚基的再生能力，在300微M浓度下观察到最大胚基长度（4.30 ± 0.12 mm，对照组为3.09 ± 0.08 mm）。组织学分析显示浓度依赖性组织修复，包括纵肌层厚度（300微M时为40.9 ± 0.43微米，对照组为29.5 ± 0.38微米）以及上皮/环肌层的扩展。定量PCR（quantitative PCR）鉴定出pex-miR-219被硒特异性抑制，表现出逐渐下调（在1微M、100微M、200微M和300微M浓度下分别为0.60、0.47、0.36和0.22倍；p < 0.001）。计算靶标预测（miRanda、RNAhybrid、RNA22）和qPCR验证确认转录因子Su(H)为pex-miR-219的高亲和力靶标，在300微M浓度下Su(H) mRNA上调8.26倍（p < 0.001）。分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟显示pex-miR-219与Su(H)之间稳定结合，表现为RMSD稳定（约4 ns后为0.25 nm）、螺旋区域低RMSF以及持续氢键（30-35个键）。这些发现确立了一个硒介导的调控轴，其中pex-miR-219的抑制解除对Su(H)的抑制，加速胚基生长和组织修复。研究表明，硒可用作影响miRNA通路的治疗手段，有助于改善愈合过程。通过阐明pex-miR-219/Su(H)相互作用，这项工作为开发基于硒的再生医学干预措施提供了分子框架，特别是针对需要加速组织修复的病症，如伤口愈合或创伤后再生。这些见解可为未来利用微量元素进行人类再生治疗中靶向基因调控的策略提供参考。补充信息：在线版本包含补充材料，可访问10.1007/s13205-025-04406-2获取。
